mapper.sql: id, ticket_id, ticket_hash, session_id, binding_operation_id, vin, account_id, relation_id, state, issued_at, expires_at, consumed_at, consumed_by, issue_seq, description, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_activation_login_ticket ( ticket_id, ticket_hash, session_id, binding_operation_id, vin, account_id, relation_id, state, issued_at, expires_at, issue_seq, row_version, row_valid ) VALUES ( #{ticketId}, #{ticketHash}, #{sessionId}, #{bindingOperationId}, #{vin}, #{accountId}, #{relationId}, #{state}, #{issuedAt}, #{expiresAt}, #{issueSeq}, 1, 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_activation_login_ticket WHERE ticket_hash = #{ticketHash} AND row_valid = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_activation_login_ticket SET state = 'REVOKED', modify_time = #{now}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND state = 'ISSUED' AND row_valid = 1

UPDATE tb_activation_login_ticket SET state = 'CONSUMED', consumed_at = #{now}, consumed_by = #{consumedBy}, modify_time = #{now}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE ticket_hash = #{ticketHash} AND state = 'ISSUED' AND expires_at > #{now} AND row_valid = 1
